name: Ancar Montclair
equipment: A plain iron holy symbol of the Eight, worn since boyhood
A quarterstaff (cloister chore-tool, doubles as the only weapon he's ever held)
A copied prayer-book, his own handwriting filling the margins
features: Dragon Skin (Breton): advantage on saving throws against spells.
Chapterhouse Ward: free bed and board at any Chapterhouse in the Empire; the clergy's trust, not yet the Vigil's authority.
LEVEL 0: no class, no subclass, no magicka, no Well. Every gate on the Vigil's Ascent is earned in play (ruleset.json Signature System 2).
background: Camlorn Chapterhouse Ward. His village on the moor edge was struck by something the survivors still won't describe properly when he was six -- his family among the dead. A Restoration priest found him sitting untouched and unhurt in the wreckage of it, and took him in less out of charity than because of something she saw in that stillness. He's spent thirteen years since as a Postulant: chores, scripture, copying ledgers, waiting for a calling nobody has yet named for him.
bonds: Mother Isolde Vance, the priestess who found him and raised him -- the only family he has, and the only person who has ever hinted she knows more about that night than she's told him.
flaws: Treats his own survival that night as a debt to be worked off rather than a mercy -- he has never once let himself simply be glad to be alive.
ideals: The unnatural preys on people who had no way to see it coming. Someone should be the one who does.
traits: Still, watchful, prays before he's decided to -- the same stillness Mother Vance first saw in him at six years old.

school_ranks._scale: untrained | novice | apprentice | journeyman | expert | master

ladder_gates.gate_0_the_postulant: open -- thirteen years a ward of the Camlorn Chapterhouse

visual_appearance.hair: dark, kept short and unfashionable, cloister-cut
visual_appearance.face: pale, unremarkable, the kind of stillness that reads as either calm or absence depending on the light
visual_appearance.eyes: grey, slow to blink, watches thresholds and shadowed corners more than faces
visual_appearance.clothing: a plain grey Postulant's habit, belted with undyed rope
visual_appearance.gear: a quarterstaff, a copied prayer-book, an iron holy symbol worn outside his collar rather than under it
visual_appearance.demeanor: quiet, formally polite, uncomfortable with idle conversation and entirely comfortable with silence
visual_appearance.size: average height, still growing into a frame built for more than cloister chores
